The Studios

Three studios. Three distinct disciplines.

Each studio within Clubist has its own identity, purpose and atmosphere. Together, they allow movement to change with the needs of the day.

I
The Mind & Body Room

Movement with intention

The Mind & Body Room is dedicated to infrared movement. Its programming spans Pilates, barre, sculpt and strength, all within an environment designed to encourage focus and precision.

The room is a state of the art infrared studio, heated to 32°C by infrared panels. Unlike conventional heating, infrared warms the body directly: a gentle, penetrating heat that deepens muscle warmth and supports mobility, circulation and depth of practice.

Heat forms part of the experience. Movement remains the priority.

AtmosphereCalm yet focused
SettingSoft textures, natural tones, considered light
SignatureInfrared panels at 32°C

Infra Form

Controlled Pilates, strengthened by infrared heat. The 32°C infrared warmth readies the muscles for deeper, more precise work.

II
The Megaformer Room

Strength through control

The Megaformer Room is dedicated to the Lagree method. Resistance. Tempo. Precision. Time under tension.

Every element, from the placement of each bed to the balance of lighting and sound, has been engineered to heighten focus and form. The method is defined by controlled movement and continuous muscular demand.

Every movement is deliberate. Every transition matters.

AtmospherePrecise and intense
EquipmentLagree Megaformers
SignatureTime under tension

Megaformer

Strength, refined through control.

The Lagree method. Slow movement, continuous resistance, complete control.

Book

Megaformer Light

The method, introduced with precision.

A measured introduction to Lagree, centred on technique and precision.

III
The Dark Room

Performance, intensified

The Dark Room brings together strength, conditioning and performance in a more immersive environment. A space designed for focus, intensity and progression.

State-of-the-art lighting and sound create an atmosphere where focus sharpens and energy rises, turning each session into an experience as precise as it is powerful.

Not just a room for exertion, but a modern arena of movement.

AtmosphereImmersive and electric
SettingState-of-the-art lighting and sound
SignatureHigher output, heavier work
